title: Request-scoped values
hints: Context values are found by key, and a plain string key can collide with any other package that happens to use the same string.
Use a key of an unexported type, such as type requestIDKey struct{}. No other package can create a value of that type, so no other package can collide with it.
context.Background() starts from scratch and loses every value. context.WithoutCancel(ctx) keeps ctx's values but is never cancelled, which is what work that must outlive the request needs.
